caseName: Boston Elevated Railway Co. v. Commissioner
caseNameFull: Boston Elevated Railway Co. v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Messrs. Charles W. Mulcahy, Robert N. Miller, and John H. Moran for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. Sewall Key, Joseph M. Jones, and Archibald Cox for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the First Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
